confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough aggregates. Sources are crowd-sourced or undated, and the Krabi-specific street-food figure is several years old. Cocktail and wine anchors are inferred from the beer anchor, not from Krabi price data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Krabi and Ao Nang, with no accommodation search, so they are lower confidence. FX: the only RBA USD/AUD figure I could find was 0.7088 dated 2026-03-20, reported in a search summary that cited the RBA exchange-rates page. I did not open that page directly and could not confirm a more recent observation for 2026-10-16, so this value may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against other Thai tourist cities (Phuket and Chiang Mai, where beer and cappuccino data were available) and Krabi-specific budget guides for local restaurant meals. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of the Krabi Town and Ao Nang tourist-accommodation range.
